title: Consultor SAP QM Sênior
description:
A NEORIS, agora parte da EPAM, é uma Aceleradora Digital que ajuda empresas a darem o próximo passo em direção ao futuro. Temos mais de 20 anos de experiência como parceiros digitais de algumas das maiores empresas do mundo. Somos mais de 4.000 profissionais em 11 países, com uma cultura multicultural e de startup, na qual cultivamos a inovação e o aprendizado contínuo para criar soluções de alto valor para nossos clientes.
 

Acreditamos que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação. Por isso, todas as nossas oportunidades estão abertas para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, raça, idade, identidade, orientação ou condição. 

Localidade: Rio de Janeiro - Centro 

Modelo de atuação: Presencial 

Formato de contratação: CLT ou PJ

Descrição do Cargo 

Buscamos um Consultor SAP S/4HANA QM Sênior para liderar o desenho funcional dos processos de qualidade em um programa de transformação baseado em Clean Core, Activate e melhores práticas SAP. O papel é central para garantir governança de qualidade, rastreabilidade, conformidade regulatória e integração total com cadeia produtiva, logística e manutenção.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenho funcional dos processos de Qualidade no SAP S/4HANA, cobrindo inspeção de recebimento, em processo, final, reclassificação, certificados e gestão de qualidade.
  • Conduzir fit-to-standard, avaliando gaps, propondo soluções escaláveis e mantendo disciplina Clean Core.
  • Estruturar estratégias de inspeção, planos de amostragem, catálogos, características, métodos e workflow de aprovação.
  • Desenhar e parametrizar integração QM–MM (recebimento, devoluções, fornecedores), QM–PP (inspeção em processo), QM–SD (inspeções de expedição), QM–PM (falhas técnicas) e QM–EWM.
  • Liderar análises de não conformidade, acionamentos de CAPA e processos de melhoria contínua.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais para ABAP/ABAP Cloud, integrações, relatórios, Fiori e workflows.
  • Conduzir testes UT/SIT/UAT, validar cenários críticos e garantir integridade dos processos regulatórios.
  • Apoiar governança de dados mestres (materiais, características, classes, planos de inspeção, catálogos e regras de decisão).
  • Participar da estratégia de cutover, readiness de operação e sustentação pós-go-live.
  • Atuar como referência e mentor técnico do módulo, orientando perfis pleno/júnior e alinhando decisões com arquitetura, PMO e área de negócios.

Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em SAP QM e vivência comprovada em projetos S/4HANA.
  • Domínio de inspeções, planos, características, amostragem, lotes, certificados, bloqueios de qualidade e workflows.
  • Experiência sólida em ambientes industriais, agro, químicos, automotivos, O&G, farmacêuticos ou de requisitos regulatórios complexos.
  • Forte domínio das integrações QM–MM, QM–PP, QM–SD, QM–EWM e QM–PM.
  • Conhecimento de Fiori Apps modernas de Qualidade e funcionalidades ampliadas do S/4HANA.
  • Capacidade de leitura técnica ABAP e elaboração de especificações funcionais de alta precisão.
  • Experiência com Signavio / SolMan / SAP ALM e governança Activate.
  • Entendimento de requisitos de auditoria, rastreabilidade, ISO, GMP, ANVISA, FDA ou equivalentes.
  • Capacidade analítica e disciplina metodológica.
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e influenciadora.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com SAP QIM (Quality Issue Management).
  • Vivência com MES integrado ao SAP.
  • Conhecimento de SAP EHS ou processos de segurança do produto.
  • Background em engenharia, qualidade industrial ou manufatura.
  • Experiência em projetos com forte auditoria e setores regulados.

Oferecemos

  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação: Benefícios mensais para suas despesas com alimentação, dentro e fora de casa. 
  • Previdência Privada: Planejamento de futuro com contribuição complementar à aposentadoria. 
  • Plano de Saúde: Cobertura médica de alta qualidade para você e seu dependente legal. 
  • Plano Odontológico: Cuidados odontológicos completos, com ampla rede de atendimento. 
  • Seguro de Vida: Proteção e segurança para você e seus entes queridos. 
  • Aulas de Inglês/Espanhol: Incentivo ao aprendizado de idiomas. 
  • Wellhub: Benefícios e descontos em academias e programas de bem-estar. 
  • Auxílio Creche: Suporte financeiro para despesas com educação infantil. 
  • Neoris Global Campus: Plataforma de desenvolvimento com oportunidades contínuas de aprendizado e crescimento profissional.

title: Account Manager
description:
At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 250 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
We are looking for an Account Manager to come and join our team, you will work closely with internal functions (Finance, Project Management, Legal, Professional Services) to execute account retention and growth strategies for Zyte's strategic accounts.  

Customer satisfaction, business retention, and portfolio growth are the key drivers of success for this position. 

Requirements

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the lead point of contact for a defined portfolio of existing business accounts.
  • Cultivate meaningful and long-lasting client relationships.
  • Negotiate contracts and close agreements to maximize profits.
  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, customer stakeholders and executive sponsors.
  • Ensure the timely and successful delivery of our solutions according to customer needs and objectives.
  • Clearly communicate the progress of monthly/quarterly initiatives to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement to meet sales quotas.
  • Forecast and track key account metrics (e.g. quarterly sales results and annual forecasts).
  • Prepare reports on account status.
  • Visiting clients and engaging with them on in person meetings
  • Assist with challenging client requests or issue escalations as needed.
  • Manage a set of Enterprise Accounts in the Americas market, individual account value between approximately $40k and $200k in annual revenues.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years in an Account Management role.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently meet and/or exceed sales quotas in revenue retention and account expansion.
  • Energy, enthusiasm and the ability to work well under pressure in meeting deadlines and achieving goals.
  • Strong deal closing and negotiation skills in Large Enterprise and Mid-market accounts
  • High level of analytical and organisational skills, and excellent attention to detail.
  • Understanding of data harvesting / web crawling a plus - but not necessary.
  • Previous experience working in consultative selling within Professional Services and SaaS Products is a must.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Commercially savvy within a Tech Scaleup company, with a proven track-record of delivering/over-delivering against Sales quotas. 
  • Demonstrated experience using sales analytics and funnel management techniques to drive productivity, pipeline management, and accurate forecasting.
  • Proven track record of collaborating with Customer Success teams to grow and expand Enterprise accounts.
Benefits

By joining the Zyte team, you will:

  • Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.
  • Have the freedom & flexibility to work remotely.
  • Get the chance to work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.

title: FF&E Procurement
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

Orchestrate relationships with top-tier suppliers / manufacturers and spearhead cost-effective procurement strategies tailored to the unique demands of our UTOPIA LIVING operations.

In general will be responsible for ordering, administration and supply procurement of the FF&E, OS&E, design and supply within the team.  It will be your responsibility to ensure that the orders are made on time, within budget and in the most efficient manner, ensuring that the Finance Department is kept informed of all necessary compliance.

At a glance:

  • FF&E/Fit Out Budgets and Cost Planning
  • Tendering and Market Research
  • Contracts and Purchase Orders management
  • Payment Forecast and Cost control
  • Logistic, Delivery and Installation plus Handover

You will:

  • Collaborate with Sr. FF&E Procurement Manager, Architects and Senior FF&E/Interior Designer to ascertain the timeline, budget and deadlines of the project
  • Assist the FF&E/Interior Designer with sourcing all the information necessary to complete the detailed specification document
  • Work with the design team to build the initial procurement schedule based on the review of layouts, renderings & specifications of the project
  • Responsible for the compilation of the procurement budget and coordinating all documentation ensuring all document standards are met
  • Organize the purchasing schedule, liaising with the Sr. Procurement and Project managers to ensure all project milestones are reached
  • Working closely with the Finance team to raise Funding Requests, produce purchase orders and pay proforma invoices in timely manner
  • Receive, approve and pass invoices for payment and log on procurement schedule
  • Liaise with suppliers across the globe to obtain quotes and discuss terms of service
  • To work within set budgets and timeframes, ensuring items meet the required specification and can be delivered on time
  • Liaise with internal teams and contractors to organize FF&E logistics and installation
  • Quality control
  • Ensure all supplier contacts are up to date
  • Carry out existing supplier reviews & new supplier visits in order to provide a list of approved suppliers to consideration on projects
  • Maintain accurate procurement & budget records & collate information for a weekly procurement review
Requirements
  • Bachelor's Degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Supply Chain or Logistic, preferably Master's degree in any of above
  • Project Management degree (Master's or equivalent) is a plus
  • Must have a minimum of 3 years experience within a procurement agency or design studio in a similar role.
  • Advanced/fluent in English and Portquese - required
  • Experience dealing with global projects and suppliers - markets across Europe, Brazil, DR, and Latin America advantageous.
  • Experience in establishing and executing new processes
  • Experience in preparing O&M Manuals for Hospitality projects
Benefits

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

title: Project Engineer Integrity
description:
The Project Engineer Integrity will support offshore projects and life‑extension activities by providing practical marine and structural engineering input. The role focuses on project execution, offshore readiness, integrity assessments, inspections, repairs, and MOC support, ensuring safe and compliant implementation of structural and marine modifications.

Responsabilities:

  • Participate in concept selection, FEED, detailed design and execution of offshore brownfield and life‑extension projects.
  • Provide marine and structural engineering input for FPSOs and other offshore structures.
  • Translate engineering deliverables into offshore execution scopes, including workpacks, methodologies, inspection strategies, and lifting/installation philosophies.
  • Interface with class societies, marine warranty surveyors, and inspection vendors on structural and marine matters.
  • Review, approve or coordinate structural analysis reports, integrity assessments, repair plans, reinforcement strategies and life‑extension studies.
  • Support offshore campaigns involving inspections, repairs, modifications, installations or remediation works.
  • Work closely with marine, construction, operations, and HSE teams to ensure offshore readiness and safe execution.
  • Provide engineering support for structural integrity, reassessment, and life‑extension of offshore assets.
  • Support Management of Change (MOC) processes related to structural and marine modifications.
  • Review inspection findings and define required repair, reinforcement or mitigation actions.
  • Support troubleshooting during offshore anomalies, impacts,or structural damage events.
  • Capture lessons learned from offshore activities and incorporate them into project practices and design standards.
Requirements

Education:

  • BSc or MSc in Civil, Structural, Offshore, or Marine Engineering.
  • Advanced degrees in Offshore Structures or Systems are considered a strong advantage.
  • Extensive relevant experience may compensate for formal education.

Experience:

  • Experience in oil & gas, ideally with offshore brownfield or FPSO background.
  • Proven experience with:

FPSOs, semisubmersibles or topside structures

Structural integrity and reassessment

Life-extension and RBI activities

Offshore inspections and repair campaigns

  • Experience working with class societies and offshore regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong exposure to project execution and offshore operations, not only design.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of:

Offshore steel structures

Structural integrity, fatigue, buckling, and yielding

Marine and structural interfaces

  • Familiarity with international standards and practices (e.g. ABS, API, ISO, DNV).
  • Experience with structural analysis and FEM tools (e.g. FEMAP/NX, ANSYS, ABAQUS).
  • Solid understanding of offshore inspection methodologies and repair techniques (including composite repairs).

title: Caldeireiro
description:
Responsabilidades

· Abaixar e apoiar a tubulação sobre selas, quando necessário; 
· Abrir boca de visita (BV) /  porta de limpeza (PL); 
· Acompanhar pressurização de sistemas para confirmação de estanqueidade de trechos; 
· Aparafusar e apertar usando técnica de sequência de aperto e torque controlado (ASME 
PCC1); 
· Conectar /desconectar flanges, uniões e acessórios; 
· Confeccionar juntas (papelão hidráulico e outros); 
· Corrigir eventuais vazamentos; 
· Desmontar e cortar se necessário;
· Desmontar e preparar estruturas antigas para reaproveitamento de materiais; 
· Desobstruir niple e válvula, usando técnicas apropriadas; 
· Desobstruir / reparar bicos aspersores; 
· Efetuar cortes, oxi-corte, calandrar, dobrar, instalar, chumbar, pontear, soldar, aparafusar e 
colar; 
· Elaborar desenho dimensional e lista de materiais; 
· Elevar tubulações com equipamento hidráulico ou talha, para permitir o acesso à parte 
inferior; 
· Execução de preparação de superfícies em locais de realização de reparos; 
· Executar alinhamento e instalar "spool" (tubulação); 
· Executar soldagem conforme procedimento aplicável; 
· Fazer rosca (recuperar rosca danificada ou fabricar rosca em peça nova); 
· Inserir ou remover peças entre flanges, como raquetes, juntas, anéis, espaçadores, figuras 8 
etc.; 
· Instalar discos de madeira para proteção, quando necessário; 
· Limpar, escovar e acondicionar os estojos e porcas, identificando-os; 
· Montagem, desmontagem e limpeza de elemento filtrante e tampa, observando sua 
substituição quando necessário; 
· Preparar chapas, tubos, vergalhões, perfis etc.; 
· Preparar peças a serem soldadas; 
· Remoção de isolamento térmico; 
· Remover chapas de reforço ou selas existentes, quando necessário; 
· Retirar bloqueios (raquetes, flanges cegos, caps etc.) e tomadas de teste hidrostático; 
· Retirar travas de segurança; 
· Soldar, utilizando varetas constituídas de material adequado considerando a união entre 
peças; 
· Travar, se necessário, hastes de válvulas a montante e a jusante de filtros; 
· E outras atividades de caldeiraria não contempladas na relação acima. 

Requirements

Formação:

· Curso de formação correlato a área de Caldeiraria do SENAI ou entidade semelhante, 
comprovado por certificado de conclusão e/ou declaração da instituição de ensino. 
· Técnico em Mecânica, comprovado por certificado de conclusão e/ou declaração da instituição 
de ensino.  

Experiência Mínima: 5 anos na área de caldeiraria e/ou mecânica industrial, comprovados através de CTPS 
e/ou declaração de empregador anterior.

title: Production Operator
description:
The Production Operator will be responsible for safely operating and monitoring the facility's process and utility systems to ensure stable and efficient offshore production. This includes operating separation, compression, dehydration, seawater injection and utility systems, preparing equipment for maintenance, performing process analyses, supporting emergency response actions, and ensuring compliance with operational and safety procedures. The role contributes to maintaining safe operations, equipment integrity, and consistent production performance.

Responsibilities

  • Start/stop and operate oil and produced gas separation plants, gas compressors, glycol dehydration, HPU systems, produced water systems and utilities.
  • Understand the safe operating limits of these systems and parameter control.
  • Start / stop and operate water cooling, coarse / fine filtration, deaeration and seawater injection systems. Understand the safe operating limits of these systems.
  • Philosophy of isolations, Permit to Work, Operational, Fire and Gas, and COSHH Task Evaluation. Basic knowledge of cause and effect.
  • Knowledge of the actions and duties of emergency event response as required in abnormal / emergency situations.
  • Knowledge and understanding of actions required to minimize commercial loss while maintaining safe operation. Prepare / isolate equipment or systems for intrusive maintenance.
  • Responsible for conservation and preservation as well as first line maintenance on production system (valves and equipment).
  • Assist and stand-by when Electrical / Instrumentation and mechanical technicians are working on process systems in order to keep the system safe to perform work.
  • Perform oil and gas pipeline cleaning activities using pigging technology.
  • Communicate effectively with co-workers and communicate any deficiencies to the Control Room Operator and Production Supervisor. Control, operate and optimize daily chemical dosing rates associated with the process system.
  • General organization and maintenance duties in work area.
  • Perform dew point analysis, TOG analysis, BSW analysis, pH analysis
  • Perform external readings according to the frequency defined by the PSUPT, verify the values with the Control Room Operator and report any deviations found to the supervisor, defining corrective measures.
  • To generate clear and simple reports aligned with the task.
  • Other duties that are related to the function, as instructed, and requested by the Production Supervisor Maintain up-to-date certification applied to his/her function and medical certificates Participate in company training, as defined.
  • Ensure compliance with BW procedures as applied to your position, including the work permit system. Comply with all emergency tasks assigned to your role in the emergency response plan, when applicable.
  • Required to be fully familiar with and comply with the Company, Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental Policies and Procedures assigned to your title / position.
  • Anticipate and realize any unsafe condition and ensure that the correct actions are taken as per procedure. Responsible for your own safety and for the safety of your co-workers.
Requirements

Education

  • Technical or equivalent qualification from the country of origin.

Experience

  • Experience in offshore production operations or similar environments.

Knowledge

  • Knowledge aligned with the company's Competence Assurance Assessment requirements.
  • Familiarity with production systems, utilities, chemical dosing, pigging operations, and laboratory/process analyses (dew point, TOG, BSW, pH).
  • Understanding of isolation philosophy, Permit to Work procedures, Fire & Gas principles, emergency response actions, and operational safety requirements.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

  • Traçar novas estratégias para melhoria de abastecimento;

  • Ampliar o monitoramento do sistema adutor;
  • Avaliar possíveis causas de avarias no sistema, calcular as perdas e oportunidades;

Rio


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Mixmax is the #1 product helping Revenue teams to become automatically proactive by eliminating busywork for a flawless customer experience

The Opportunity


We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer who wants high ownership: leading projects end-to-end, improving how services are built and operated, and creating paved paths that reduce toil across engineering. This role can be based in LATAM or Europe.

Within your first few months, you'll:

  • Ship meaningful improvements to our infrastructure, reliability and developer experience
  • Take ownership of key platform areas and processes
  • Partner with product engineers to understand pain points, unblock delivery, and raise standards and improve how we operate

Preferred skills and background:

  • Strong experience with and AWS
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform)
  • Experience operating and supporting the systems you build, not just shipping and moving on
  • Clear written communication. We're a distributed team, and documentation matters

It's also awesome (but not required) for you to have:

  • Experience with MongoDB, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, or Redis/Valkey
  • Familiarity with observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Datadog, etc.)
  • Experience building internal platforms or developer tools
  • Familiarity with microservices / event-driven / serverless architectures
  • Experience with networking (DNS, load balancing, VPCs, etc.)

How we work


We're a globally distributed team.

We default to asynchronous communication, keep meetings lightweight, and rely on strong written docs to stay aligned. Our core stack is , React, MongoDB, and AWS. We mainly use Jira and Slack day-to-day.

The Mixmax Story


At Mixmax, our vision is a world without busywork. Since our launch in 2015, Mixmax has become the product of choice for over 10,000 Sales and Customer Success teams to eliminate and automate repetitive work. This means more time to focus on what matters: engaging and serving the needs of customers.

We're extraordinarily proud of the company we've built. We're a driven, passionate, responsible group that values personal and professional growth equally. We take care of ourselves, our families, our customers, and one another. We believe in sustainable and diverse approaches to work and life, because optimizing for the long-term is the best path to success.

Our company is globally distributed, with remote team members worldwide. We offer competitive salaries, meaningful equity, and generous benefits. And with Mixmax, you get to work on a product people love.

Why Mixmax?

  • We're a product-led company with strong product–market fit, ambitious new AI initiatives, and a clear mission
  • You'll join at a pivotal moment - shaping the next generation of our platform and helping define how Mixmax scales technically and culturally.
  • You'll work in a team that values ownership, creativity, and building things that matter, where good ideas can come from anywhere.
  • You'll have autonomy, trust, and direct access to leadership, with the support to explore high-leverage opportunities and make real impact.

Ready to lead and build at scale with a team that moves fast and cares deeply? We'd love to hear from you.

title: Camicado - Jovem Aprendiz | Norte Shopping/RJ

A Camicado é a marca do Ecossistema de Moda e Lifestyle da Lojas Renner S.A. especializada em casa e decoração, oferecendo os melhores produtos e serviços com muita qualidade, modernidade e afeto. Um aeroporto com a alma carioca

O RIOgaleão é o maior equipamento urbano do Rio de Janeiro, com grande importância para a economia do estado. Ao longo de 10 anos de operação, recebemos mais de 100 milhões de passageiros, fomos o aeroporto Olímpico, vimos a cura da Covid chegar pelo nosso Terminal de Cargas e somos a porta de entrada para os principais eventos da cidade.

Nosso Jeito RIOgaleão de Ser abraça a diversidade, por isso, nossos processos seletivos são abertos à todos, afinal trabalhamos todos os dias para a verdadeira conexão.

Se você se identifica com esses valores e deseja fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica e que adora desafios, temos uma oportunidade como Analista de Marketing e Inteligência de Mercado Pleno – Aviação.

Nesse desafio, você irá trabalhar para que as iniciativas de desenvolvimento de passageiros sejam baseadas em uma compreensão holística dos respectivos mercados e suas dinâmicas. Pesquisas frequentes sobre o comportamento do consumidor, com identificação dos canais adequados e eficazes e de potenciais parceiros fazem parte do briefing. O analista também desenvolverá cases de negócios completos, defendendo os investimentos em campanhas e iniciativas de marketing, bem como promoverá análises pós-campanha, além de gerenciar e priorizar o orçamento da diretoria.

Esse desafio requer que você desempenhe as seguintes atividades:

  • Ser responsável por coletar, analisar e apresentar dados relevantes para ajudar a construir a estratégia de marketing de aviação e iniciativas táticas;
  • Estabelecer uma estrutura robusta para análise de mercado em preparação de campanhas de estímulo à demanda;
  • Desenvolver cases de negócios robustos para defender o investimento e as metas de todas as campanhas/iniciativas de marketing de aviação;
  • Desenvolver análises pós-campanha com KPIs de marketing digital, em relação à conscientização, conversão e receita;
  • Preparar e monitorar o orçamento da Diretoria de Negócios Aéreos e apoiar a priorização da alocação de recursos;
  • Estar sempre por dentro das tendências emergentes da indústria e do comportamento do consumidor, tanto do mercado interno quanto do exterior;
    Estabelecer e manter fortes relações com o trade turístico e entidades governamentais para coletar e fornecer dados e estudos de inteligência de mercado.

Habilidades e qualificações necessárias:

  • Formação em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Estatística, Marketing ou Correlatos;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Conhecimento avançado de Pacote Office (Excel, Powerpoint, Word);
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Power BI, Google Data Studio/Looker, Google Analytics;
  • Compreensão e habilidade de trabalho com bases de dados;
  • Conhecimento de Marketing Digital;
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico, com alta capacidade crítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade e capacidade de multitarefa;
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação;
  • Perfil enérgico para se engajar em novos projetos e ideias;
  • Automotivação e iniciativa para trabalhar de forma independente e como parte de uma equipe;
  • Possuir as Atitudes GATE do Integrante RIOgaleão: Garra e Determinação, Autodesenvolvimento, Trabalho em Equipe e Espírito de Dono.

Você sai na frente se tiver:

  • Experiência prática relacionada à aviação/ turismo;
  • Habilidades de programação;
  • Espanhol Básico;
  • Perfil analítico, estratégico, com alta capacidade crítica e de resolução de problemas.

title: Engenheiro Mecânico
description:
Descrição da empresa

A Turner & Townsend é uma empresa global de serviços profissionais com mais de colaboradores em mais de 60 países. Trabalhando com nossos clientes nos setores de imobiliário, infraestrutura, energia e recursos naturais, transformamos juntos, entregando resultados que melhoram a vida das pessoas.

Trabalhamos em parceria e tornamos possível entregas dos projetos e programas mais impactantes do mundo, transformando desafios em oportunidades e complexidade em sucesso.

Nossos serviços incluem Gestão de Programas, Projetos, Custos, Ativos e Comercial, Controles e Desempenho, Compras e Cadeia de suprimentos, soluções para emissões zero e Digital.

Somos majoritariamente de propriedade do CBRE Group, Inc., a maior empresa de serviços imobiliários comerciais e investimentos do mundo, com nossos parceiros detendo uma participação minoritária significativa. Turner & Townsend e CBRE trabalham juntos para fornecer aos clientes a melhor oferta de gestão de programas, projetos e custos em mercados ao redor do mundo.

Descrição da vaga

  • Analisar projetos e desenhos técnicos de sistemas HVAC e utilidades, assegurando conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais.
  • Supervisionar a instalação de sistemas de ar-condicionado (VRF, split, chillers, fancoils, AHU/UTA), ventilação e exaustão em ambientes comerciais, industriais ou institucionais e sistemas de filtragem de ar.
  • Apoiar equipe de PMO no desenvolvimento de cronogramas de execução e na elaboração de estimativas de custo e planejamento físico-financeiro.
  • Fiscalizar a instalação de sistemas de armazenamento e distribuição de água, sistemas de combate a incêndio, armazenamento e distribuição de gases especiais e efluentes industriais, armazenamento e distribuição de ar comprimido e geração e distribuição de vapor;
  • Realizar inspeções técnicas em dutos, equipamentos e componentes de HVAC, garantindo a qualidade da instalação.
  • Planejar e acompanhar atividades de testes, pré-comissionamento e comissionamento dos sistemas.
  • Aplicar normas de segurança e boas práticas de engenharia durante todas as fases do projeto.
  • Participar de revisões de projeto e reuniões técnicas com clientes, projetistas e empreiteiros.
  • Garantir a correta interpretação de escopos e documentos técnicos, esclarecendo dúvidas da equipe de campo.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e participar de reuniões de acompanhamento com stakeholders.
  • Manter comunicação constante com as operações do cliente para alinhar intervenções e minimizar impactos nas áreas ocupadas.

Qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em supervisão de projetos HVAC e sistemas de utilidades.
  • Desejável experiência em projetos e/ou obras de indústrias farmacêuticas, laboratórios, hospitais e similares;
  • Graduação em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento técnico em sistemas de ar-condicionado central, automação predial, ventilação e exaustão.
  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas (ASHRAE, ABNT, NR-13, NR-35, entre outras).
  • Experiência com sistemas de proteção contra incêndio será um diferencial.
  • Domínio das ferramentas do Microsoft Office.

Informações adicionais

Nossos profissionais inspirados compartilham nossa visão e missão. Oferecemos um excelente local de trabalho, onde cada pessoa tem a oportunidade e a voz para promover mudanças.

Queremos que nossos profissionais tenham sucesso tanto no trabalho quanto na vida pessoal e por isso promovemos um ambiente de trabalho saudável, produtivo e flexível que respeita o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Inquietos e Acelerados. Criativos ou Cartesianos. Talentosos e Autodidatas. Artesanais ou Tecnológicos. Não importa: gostamos de diversidade e de quem está aqui para agregar.

Porque GENTE É O QUE SOMA.

Estamos construindo o time de AI que vai transformar a forma como a empresa resolve problemas reais, toma decisões e opera no dia a dia. Nosso objetivo é levar a inteligência artificial para além de experimentos, tornando seu uso prático, responsável e parte natural da rotina das áreas. Aqui, AI é ferramenta de impacto: usada com senso crítico, foco em valor e liberdade para experimentar, aprender e evoluir continuamente.

Se você gosta de construir soluções, explorar novas possibilidades e aplicar AI de forma concreta, esse é o lugar.

QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

pilar técnico e cultural de AI da empresa
, responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a stack de AI, acelerando os times de projeto e garantindo que a adoção de AI aconteça com qualidade técnica, segurança e impacto real no negócio — sem burocracia excessiva.

Esse papel é
hands-on por natureza
, com forte viés de arquitetura e evangelização, atuando como referência técnica e catalisador da maturidade de AI na companhia.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de AI da empresa.
  • Estabelecer diretrizes de governança técnica, avaliando riscos em soluções de AI.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para analistas e times de tecnologia, apoiando decisões arquiteturais e desbloqueando problemas complexos.
  • Acompanhar ativamente a evolução do ecossistema de AI (GenAI, agentes, plataformas, frameworks) e desafiar continuamente a stack atual.
  • Atuar em casos estratégicos ou de maior risco, seja de forma direta ou consultiva.
  • Promover upskilling técnico e cultural, ajudando a tornar AI parte da rotina de diferentes áreas, não apenas da tecnologia.
  • Traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos de AI em implicações práticas de negócio, risco e escalabilidade.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS:

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de software e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Capacidade de desenhar e implementar soluções de AI end-to-end, usando código, plataformas e ferramentas de forma pragmática.
  • Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de dados e AI (cloud, pipelines, APIs, automações, agentes).
  • Forte domínio de pensamento arquitetural, trade-offs técnicos e avaliação de riscos.
  • Facilidade em usar modelos de AI para acelerar desenvolvimento em múltiplas linguagens.
  • Aplicação prática de soluções de AI a problemas reais.

REQUISITOS COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  • Perfil naturalmente curioso e engajado com novas soluções de AI.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

  • Postura de parceiro.

title: Bid Specialist
description:
Overview:

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward—we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.

Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME IN ENGLISH

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

Responsible for supporting the commercial management of business opportunities across the full opportunity and proposal lifecycle, as part of the Commercial Management Team dedicated to the C&DE portfolio.

The role plays an active part within the Bid Team, contributing to the development of commercially sound, competitive, and compliant proposals by shaping pricing, commercial assumptions, and overall deal structure, in line with customer requirements and SITA's corporate and governance guidelines

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Develop and execute deal strategies for complex, renewal, and new business opportunities.
  • Define deal structure, pricing, and competitive positioning in collaboration with Sales and Business Development.
  • Prepare and analyze commercial proposals for management review.
  • Assess financial, contractual, regulatory, delivery, and lifecycle impacts of deals.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather inputs and meet customer requirements.
  • Support the bid project plan and contribute to proposal development as part of the Bid Team.
  • Consolidate inputs from partners, subcontractors, and third parties into the proposal.
  • Develop and maintain financial models, including pricing, capex, and cash flow analysis.
  • Ensure compliance with governance, bid processes, and approval frameworks.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and issues clearly to management and stakeholders.

Qualifications:

ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

  • B. A. or equivalent professional qualifications in Engineering, Economics, Business Administration, Finance or Legal
  • At least 2 years of commercial, pricing, bid or proposal experience with project management abilities.
  • Must have sound understanding in Sales Cycles, Proposal Management, Business Development and Account Management
  • Experience in aviation industry or IT is a plus.
  • Relevant understanding of the airport and/or airline operation is an advantage.
  • Ability in developing successful relationships at Senior Manager level.

WHAT WE OFFER

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

  • Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning

Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

title: Core Experience Engineer
description:
About The Role
We are looking for a Core Experience Engineering Lead to guide a small, high-impact engineering team at TestBox. You will act as both a technical leader and hands-on contributor, ensuring our core systems are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with company goals. This role combines team leadership, architectural ownership, and cross-functional collaboration with Product and Design.

  • Building trust and rapport with your team through effective 1:1s and mentorship

  • Own the technical vision for core systems, ensuring scalability and performance

  • Introduce new technologies, practices, and patterns to improve the platform
  • Represent the engineering perspective in strategic company discussions

  • 6–8 years of software development experience, ideally in full-stack systems

  • Strong coding background, with 1–2 years of experience in Python and React
  • Proven ability to mentor and support engineers' professional growth
  • Experience designing scalable database architectures
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies and product-driven development
  • Comfortable with AWS products
  • Advanced English (C1 or C2), both written and spoken

Preferred Qualifications

  • Track record of shaping frontend or full-stack architecture at scale
  • Background in driving UI/UX improvements for technical products

Compensation & Logistics

  • Salary: $80,000 USD + Equity & Benefits

Administração de Ambiente Microsoft: Sustentação de servidores Windows Server (2016 a 2022), incluindo Active Directory (AD), DNS, DHCP, GPO e File Server.

Monitoramento de Links: Acompanhar a latência e estabilidade dos links de comunicação, acionando operadoras e garantindo o failover se necessário.

title: Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions
description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer with extensive experience in Oil Reservoir Management to join our Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran. Our Center provides expert advice and guidance on all aspects of oil reservoir management, including designing, participating in and implementing best‑in‑class reservoir management programs. This position is embedded within the Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical specialist, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Your primary role is to manage some of the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields, conduct pioneering research, introduce new technologies and provide specialized engineering services as part of the customized reservoir management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight on best-in-class reservoir management tenets, practices and state of the art technologies for all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance and monitoring master-plans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.
  • Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both net present value and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare reservoir engineering input into drilling and work-over proposals and programs.
  • Recommend advanced completion techniques for horizontal and multi-lateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies that include reservoir stimulation modeling of various International Offshore Rule (IOR) processes for improvement of ultimate recovery.
  • Participate in technical societies and technical groups.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor degree in Petroleum Engineering or related discipline. A Master degree or PhD is desirable, but not required.
  • Have a minimum of 10 years related experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management. A training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected. Technical publications are valued but in‑depth practical experience is paramount.
  • Must have full professional proficiency in English required to interact and communicate clearly with specialists in geology, core and fluid analysis, petrophysics, simulation, drilling, completion, production and facilities.
  • Must have working knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures, strategy technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis and fluid compatibility. Additionally, expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are desirable but not required.
  • Must have history of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

Senior Mobile Software Engineer - Nubank

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank.

Our Mobile Platform’s mission aligns with Nubank’s commitment to delivering the best experience for our customers by ensuring a high-performing, stable, and seamless app. Within Mobile Platform, App Core focuses on providing user-friendly, scalable, high-performing, and cost-efficient app infrastructure components and mobile tools that enable Nubank engineers to quickly and safely test, deploy, monitor, analyze, and improve app flows and features. App Core powers app performance, infrastructure scalability, and removal of legacy dependencies to allow our application to grow from millions to potentially billions of customers.

The Opportunity : This role will involve working across a variety of technologies, including Native , Flutter , and related frameworks. We are looking for a Mobile Engineer with solid experience to join the App Core team – a cross-impact engineering team responsible for building and maintaining the core infrastructure of the mobile application, optimizing our performance, and enabling product teams to deliver high-quality mobile experiences.

Must Have

  • Proven experience in senior-level technical mobile development.
  • Strong technical background with Flutter and/or native mobile development (Android/iOS).
  • Solid understanding of mobile software engineering principles, architectural patterns, and modularization strategies.
  • Experience with performance optimization, dependency injection, and migration of core systems.
  • Knowledge of mobile observability, monitoring, and debugging tools.
  • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Track record of delivering results in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with backend technologies, especially those integrated with mobile applications.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and large-scale app architecture.
  • Contributions to internal SDKs, libraries, or mobile design systems.
  • Understanding of user authentication, session management, and app state handling.

Why Join Us

  • Impact at Scale: Help shape the mobile experience for millions of customers across multiple countries, with the goal of reaching billions.
  • Technical Leadership: Influence the architecture and foundational technologies that all Nubank engineers rely on.
  • Innovation-Driven Culture: Work in a dynamic, collaborative environment that values experimentation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

Revisar e garantir a organização e controle de todos os documentos relacionados aos processos no sistema de gestão (ex: DOO), assegurando sua rastreabilidade e fácil acesso. Preparar e organizar a documentação e processos referentes à acreditação hospitalar da unidade, montando apresentações para auditorias e liderando o processo para o sucesso da certificação.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe: Supervisionar e orientar diariamente as atividades dos técnicos de engenharia clínica, garantindo a qualidade e eficiência na execução dos serviços de manutenção, calibração e ensaios. Garantir a replicação e adesão da equipe aos treinamentos ministrados pela empresa, bem como promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico com a equipe e com o corpo assistencial do cliente.
  • Gestão da Manutenção e Otimização do Parque Tecnológico: Garantir a resolutividade das solicitações de manutenção corretiva, supervisionando o diagnóstico, a cotação de peças/acessórios e a proposição de soluções eficazes. Elaborar pareceres técnicos e laudos de obsolescência de equipamentos, baseando-se no histórico e normativas, para subsidiar a avaliação do parque tecnológico do cliente.

Relacionar e controlar pedidos de materiais, acessórios e peças de reposição para garantir a eficiência e a continuidade do funcionamento dos Equipamentos Médico-Hospitalares (EMH), gerenciando o estoque no SGM.

Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações, conforme a necessidade do cliente, com o objetivo de ampliar o escopo de serviços e soluções oferecidas.

Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo, delegadas pelo coordenador de engenharia clínica ou superior imediato.

description:
Software Platform Engineering Manager – Ubuntu for Next‑Gen Silicon

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT.

With more than 1,200 colleagues in 75 countries, Canonical is a founder‑led, profitable, and constantly growing company that champions global distributed collaboration. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person at interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution. This is a globally remote role with open positions in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform‑oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we’re looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC‑V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross‑compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring‑up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil
description:
Bruna Carvalho appointed to Managing Director, Brazil

Share

We are delighted to announce that Bruna Carvalho has been appointed to Managing Director, Brazil, effective immediately.

Bruna joined Clarksons in September 2024 and is now firmly establishing Clarksons’ Deep-Sea Tanker desk in Rio de Janeiro. South America is becoming an increasingly significant market. Providing an on-the-ground presence in the region ensures Clarksons is well placed to support clients as the market and opportunity grows. Bruna’s 18-year career at Petrobras has afforded her a wealth of experience and leadership expertise.

“Bruna has demonstrated impact since day one – she fits in well to the Clarksons culture, has contributed tremendously to the relaunch of Clarksons in Rio and has established herself as a strong leader. We are confident that her vision and drive will be instrumental in shaping the next exciting phase of our growth and success in the region, and that she will contribute hugely to the global management team at Clarksons.”

Andi Case

CEO

“My first 9 months at Clarksons have been fantastic. First and foremost, my focus is establishing the tankers presence - nurturing new and existing client relationships and demonstrating the insight and expertise that is available when partnering with Clarksons. I’ve had the opportunity to represent the business at global events, to connect and contribute towards internal networks within Clarksons, and together with the team have shaped our brand-new office space - I feel empowered and very proud to be part of this dynamic and forward-thinking business.”

The Brazil office currently has 20 employees across four service lines – Deep Sea Tankers, Specialised Products, Dry Cargo and Offshore & Renewables. A special mention must go to Jens Behrendt who has laid very strong foundations in the running of the office to date and will continue to head up the region’s Offshore and Renewables desk. Last month, the team hosted a joint celebration with more than 500 clients at the top of Sugar Loaf Mountain, to mark the new office opening in the centre of Rio, providing the space to scale and more than double headcount over the next couple of years.
